compiler.role: participant wrapper and grading, frozen for both policies

participant.budget_disclosure: the cap sentence is in the prompt and in every raw session log

corpus.note: the digest pins the corpus as it is on disk (14 case directories) and is unchanged; the DESIGN list below is the 13 distinct tasks

excluded.reason: project/, public/ and hidden/ are byte-identical and request.md is identical; case.json differs only in id; the rendered prompts hash the same
excluded.effect: excluded before any session; effective paired n = 13

dev_case_overlap.effect: the pilot's dev cells ran on three instances that are also M2 design cases, so the pilot's spend figures describe some of M2's own tasks and its 'no prior trajectories' claim does not hold for them; no treatment contamination in M2 (fresh sessions, no tuning)

cases.why_not_dev: cap 5000 does not bind on the dev cases (pilot's largest dev cell 2592 = 51.8% of cap); on the test corpus the M1b replay bounds 3 of 14 repair tasks at cap 5000 and keeps 11 answers — note those replay denominators count the duplicated variant task twice, so they are indicative rather than this 13-case sheet's own denominators

design.cap_unit: generated (output) tokens per model call, reasoning included once
design.envelope: one per task, shared by every candidate of that task and by the selection step

repair.end: an overshoot ends the task's only candidate; the task keeps no answer

independent.start_rule: another candidate starts only while remaining() > 0 (and within the pool bound of `unresolved`)
independent.envelope: each candidate charges the SAME envelope instance
independent.live_vs_replay: live there is no look-ahead: a call's size is unknown until it is generated, so a candidate's FIRST call may itself overshoot and end the cell; the replay could refuse to start a candidate whose first call did not fit, so live independent is weakly more expensive per started candidate and the replay's 'unstarted' counts have no live counterpart

selection.rule: public check only; the hidden manifest runs once, on the selected answer, and never chooses
selection.selected: first complete public-passing candidate, else the last complete candidate, else nothing
selection.no_selection: the task contributes no answer and hidden_acceptance is null (never false)

primary.accepted: A(c,p) = 1 iff the selected answer passes the hidden manifest; no selection => 0

metrics.acceptance_ceiling_note: M1b's unbudgeted sessions accepted 111/112 hidden cohort-wide (the text arm 28/28), so acceptance may sit at ceiling and the cost-per-answer comparison is the informative part
metrics.honest_bound: live spend is bounded by cap + the overshooting call, never by the cap alone: the harness can only stop the participant after that call's usage line is written

candidate_end_semantics.rule: an overshoot-ended candidate is incomplete and unselectable EVEN WHEN its sealed snapshot passes public and hidden; this binds both policies symmetrically and is a deliberate commitment device

observed_instance.meaning: the envelope discarded an answer that was already correct because the task closed 131 generated tokens past a cap of 1000

states.signal: the process died from the signal the harness sent (success)
states.graceful-after-request: SIGTERM sent, process reaped inside the grace window, and no call charged after the refusal (success; the expected `dsh` shape)
states.none: no stop requested, process outlived the grace window, or calls continued after the refusal (failure)

stop_semantics.launcher_note: dsh --profile headless installs process.on('SIGTERM', () => interrupt(0)) (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/profile-boot-Dk-7KqJc.js) and exits 0, so a signal-exit predicate is structurally unreachable for this launcher; v1's binary killed_by_harness was the wrong predicate
mechanism_failures_fire_on: any call charged after the refusal without the after_overshoot flag
a candidate that overshot yet is marked complete
stop_semantics.graceful_after_request_is: a SUCCESS, not a mechanism failure
stop_semantics.strictness: one call charged after the refusal downgrades the cell to stop: none; late_calls_after_stop and the late call keys are recorded so an in-flight flush is distinguishable from continued generation

sensitivities_predeclared: the primary rule on the public-acceptance denominator
the primary rule on input volume per accepted answer
the same rule re-including variant-b (the duplicate), to show what the corrected case list avoids; reported as a defect-sensitivity and never as the design

'correct at kill': count and cost of overshoot-ended candidates whose sealed snapshot passes public and hidden (graded out of band, no model calls), reported separately and never substituted for the primary metric

analysis.pairing: paired by case, treatment - baseline, per family; pooled only as a secondary view

interval.detail: resample the group's case indices with replacement and evaluate both policies on the same drawn cases

acceptance_contrasts.method: exact two-sided McNemar (binomial) on discordant pairs, plus a paired bootstrap interval on the difference of proportions

decision_rule.estimand: dR = R_independent - R_repair per group (positive = independent costs more per accepted answer)
decision_rule.equivalence_margin_unit: generated tokens per accepted answer (one fifth of the per-task cap)

outcomes.no_separation: lo >= -delta and hi <= +delta; materiality outranks significance (an interval inside the margin is no separation even if it excludes 0)
outcomes.policy_wins: hi < -delta => independent wins; lo > +delta => repair wins
outcomes.inconclusive: every other interval (it contains a value inside the margin and is not wholly inside it)

families_with_fewer_than_two_pairs.rule: reported descriptively (point estimate and raw numbers only; no interval is formed), excluded from the overall composition, and the exclusion is stated wherever the overall state appears

degenerate_denominator.one_policy_zero_accepted: that policy cannot win the group; if the other accepts >= 1 the group is a win for it, flagged denominator-degenerate
degenerate_denominator.both_zero_accepted: the group is inconclusive (nothing to price)

decision_rule.acceptance_cost_clause: a primary win accompanied by a significantly negative paired acceptance difference is recorded as a win AND annotated 'with an acceptance deficit'

overall_composition.over: the families with at least 2 paired cases

decision_rule.pooled: same rule over all 13 design cases, reported as a secondary view only and never overriding a family state

discipline.missing_or_invalid: stay visible, never imputed, never counted as zero spend
discipline.retry: a new attempt with a reason; attempt 1 is preserved and never overwritten
discipline.spend: per-call ground truth; each call's usage counted once and deduplicated by (session, call index); the log carries each usage twice (data.usage and a trailing stream chunk)
discipline.audit: every cell audited against the frozen digests; records are audited under the mechanism rule of the runner sha they name
discipline.frozen_artifact_change: re-freeze this sheet before the first session; a record whose runner_sha256 is not the frozen one is not an M2 observation

sessions.ceiling_formula: 13 repair sessions + 13 x M independent sessions

unresolved.question: how many independent candidates may a cell start, and is there a per-candidate sub-allowance?
